title: nano banana
category: sub-skill of image-to-react · targeted bucket 2x upscaler & readiness eval
short_summary: upgrades only upscale-queue image slots to 2x retina with zero drift and enforces non-blur readiness via eval-image-readiness.py.
when_to_use: use in stage 1b of jason-dev-agent only on mounted image buckets flagged below 2x retina or blurry by eval-image-readiness.py.
summary: Converts low-resolution source mockups, compressed screenshots, and soft or dithered cropped photographic assets into crisp 2x Retina and 4K high-resolution plates using Nano Banana with zero semantic drift. Handles faithful 1-to-1 super-resolution, diffusion grain and JPEG de-dithering, ultra-wide banner aspect padding, and clean removal of baked-in raster text overlays behind live HTML typography, stopping for a deterministic dev eval followed by a paired material and visual critique in jason-design-agent. Use whenever a reference image or extracted photo crop in jason-dev-agent is low-resolution, blurry, dithered, or below 2x CSS Retina dimensions. Don't use for UI buttons, icons, or typography that belong as native HTML, CSS, and inline SVG (use replicate-mock and image-to-react).
